name: devforge
description: DevForge Chrome extension. No build step; this file only holds the dev scripts.

scripts.verify:all: npm run lint && npm run verify

//: The extension itself needs no install. Node 18+ runs check/test/backup; ESLint (devDependencies) needs Node 20.19+ or 22.13+. The minimatch override replaces the copy ESLint pulls in (10.2.6, which has an advisory for patterns from untrusted input) until ESLint ships a patched one.
